notes.title: Patch 1.4.6
notes.content: Patch 1.4.6 contains a fix for an issue causing Campaign progress to be reset between launches. Users who experienced this issue will have their progress restored.

notes.title: Raiders of the North Sea Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35489699/db8a8a90f625bfcae8673d08b6e88baa000dc283.png[/img]
[b]Bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed bug where some challenges could get stuck
[*] Fixed bug where players could not get correctly pulled into a multiplayer game when it starts
[*] Mac version can now run on Catalina OSX[/list]

notes.title: Raiders of the North Sea Patch 1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35489699/40cf5964fd4b8d2a4cb1fb3c094130dec2f7fa8c.png[/img]
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list][*] AI has improved further! Normal mode has been taken up a notch! We’ve also introduced Novice mode.
[*] You’ll now see a progress bar on the continue games screen so you can better gauge how much longer a player has before their turn is up
[*] Added the ability to friend players after you finish a match with them
[*] You can now save and resume pass and play games[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t zoom in to see your crew 
[*] Fixed bug where card backgrounds wouldn’t show up
[*] Fixed bug preventing users from viewing the tooltip for Valkyrie & Armour track info
[*] Fixed friend match bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Raiders of the North Sea Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35489699/c56dd8ab30400e8be72d1c80a349c39c6acccf2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New features and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pass & Play game mode has been added!
[*] Initial AI Improvements
[list]
[*]Initial pass on AI logic improvements have been made.
[*]Ragnarok mode! A special AI challenge game mode.
[*]Later Campaign games are now more challenging
[*]More to come! Additional AI improvements and support for a Solo Variant are on their way.
[/list]
[*] Added option to speed up animations during your opponent’s turn.
[*] Camera will auto pan back to the village after your turn.
[*] You are now given an option to continue or start your game new, when resuming a game versus the AI.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] More improvements to make it easier to drag and drop your workers.
[*] Fixed bug so the game is easier to play on trackpads.
[*] Fixed bug where you could get notified to jump to a different game, while you were still taking your turn during Valkyrie selection.
[*] Bug fix for “Pay Less” challenge.
[*] Rules updated to include victory point amounts you get from the Valkyrie track.
[/list]
